_comment: Strings the design drop does not ship: accessibility labels, the cookie-consent banner (the drop has none, though its own cookie policy promises one), the shortened mobile announcement, and newsletter consent wording. Authored here rather than in ui.json so content/ui.json stays a faithful extract of the drop. Deep-merged over ui.json by scripts/build-pages.js.
